Herb Platter

Served at: Yalda Night

Serves 6-8Prep 15 min

An Herb Platter is a traditional accompaniment served during Yalda Night, the Persian celebration of the winter solstice. It features a variety of fresh herbs that symbolize renewal and health, complementing the festive spread of fruits, nuts, and sweets.

Ingredients

  • 1 cup fresh basil leaves
  • 1 cup fresh mint leaves
  • 1 cup fresh tarragon leaves
  • 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves
  • 1 cup fresh parsley leaves
  • 1 cup fresh dill sprigs
  • 1 cup fresh chives, chopped
  • 1 lemon, sliced for garnish
  • 1 small bowl of sea salt for dipping

Method

  1. Rinse all fresh herbs thoroughly under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
  2. Arrange the herbs decoratively on a large serving platter, grouping each type separately for easy identification.
  3. Place lemon slices around the edges of the platter for garnish and a touch of color.
  4. Serve the herb platter alongside the main dishes, with a small bowl of sea salt for guests to dip the herbs if desired.

Tips

  • Use the freshest herbs available for the best flavor and aroma.
  • You can add other seasonal herbs like savory or oregano based on availability and preference.
  • Serve the herb platter chilled or at room temperature for optimal freshness.
